description:
Project # 42M-08501-5J, Repair Fire Damage, Bldg. # 608, Room 207, USAG Bavaria, Grafenwoehr Military Community – Rose Barracks which requires the following work:

  • Dismantling, thorough cleaning, intermediate storage and re-mounting of sanitary equipment.
  • Dismantling of the gypsum board ceiling and installation of a new ceiling.
  • Basic cleaning of tile flooring and new wall tiling on top of existing tiling (except for the shower area).
  • Basic cleaning of tiling and installation of water-tight sandwich slabs as new walls panels (shower area).
  • Cleaning of wall and ceiling surfaces in the living/sleeping space of the apartment and subsequent new paint finish.
  • Thorough cleaning of all floors as well as coating of PVC flooring.
  • Replacing broken fly screen in window.
  • Replace bathroom mirror cabinet including lighting.
  • Install new ceiling lighting and fan in bathroom.
  • Cut vent holes into bathroom door
  • Install new ceiling lighting in living space and hallway

Perform final cleaning of all installed equipment, light switches, power outlets, radiators, doors and windows
